title: Fuse the 27B target-verify chain to remove avoidable HBM round trips
reasons: veto: most favourable defensible speedup 1.0033x < veto line 1.15x
measurement band is parametric, n=1, source=private archive p0-2026-11-13#measured_e2e.c1_short_ctx_short_out
claim capped by accounting: claimed 0.3811 ms > allowed 0.0559 ms (bytes 0.0559 / time 0.0000)
hypothesis: A persistent megakernel over the 64-layer verify chain removes the layer-boundary and GDN/MLP intermediate HBM round trips plus the inter-layer sync, yielding >= 1.3x on a c1 short-context decode step.

mechanism.name: persistent layer/chain megakernel removing intermediate round trips
mechanism.justification: 139,984,896 B of GDN intermediates + 34,078,720 B of attention intermediates + 10,485,760 B of layer-boundary hidden writes are written and re-read per step. At 3.30 TB/s that is 0.056 ms of the 17.23 ms step - a 0.33 % traffic share. The mechanism cannot claim the sync/tail residual because that is not attributable to the byte ledger.
